title_zh: v210：几何可观测性强烈偏向虚拟环形族，但固定谱下限未能严格分离
title_en: v210: Geometry observability strongly favors the virtual-ring family, but the fixed spectral floor does not strictly separate it

fixed_primary.name: smallest nonnegative eigenvalue of the trace-normalized 64-mode observability Gram matrix
fixed_primary.strict_success_rule: every virtual-nine metric must exceed every supplied-nine metric

interpretation_zh: 固定的几何可观测性指标在169个跨族配对中有167个偏向虚拟九相机，并给出约14.3倍的中位谱下限和约13.1倍更低的中位条件数，说明几何/条件性是Case 5 reference充分性的主要因素。但虚拟九相机最小谱下限仍低于师兄标定族的最大值，两个配对反向，未达到严格169/169分离。该固定64维谱下限不能单独作为充分性分类器。
interpretation_en: The fixed geometry-only observability metric favors virtual nine cameras in 167 of 169 cross-family pairs, with about a 14.3-fold higher median spectral floor and about a 13.1-fold lower median condition number. Geometry and conditioning are therefore major factors in Case 5 reference adequacy. However, the smallest virtual-nine spectral floor remains below the largest supplied-family value, reversing two pairwise comparisons. The fixed 64-mode floor does not strictly separate the families and is not a sufficient classifier by itself.
route_action_zh: 关闭把这一个固定低模谱下限当作充分分类器的解释；不得事后调阈值、换基或挑其他诊断量包装成功。下一步只接受配对真实BOST物理数据，或一个结果前冻结且物理上不同的几何机制。预测器、资源门和GPU继续不授权。
route_action_en: Close the interpretation that this fixed low-mode spectral floor is a sufficient classifier. Do not retune thresholds, replace the basis, or select another diagnostic after seeing the result. The next gate requires paired real-BOST physical data or a preregistered, physically distinct geometry mechanism. Predictor, resource, and GPU stages remain unauthorized.
